environment.description: Same service deployed behind ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL association. The WebACL includes a rule group reference statement pointing to a CUSTOM rule group (not AWS managed) named 'tf-artifact-upload-inspection' with priority 1. This rule group contains a single RegexPatternSet-based rule that inspects the BODY of requests matching /api/v1/artifacts/upload with a field-to-match on 'SingleQueryArgument' named 'category'. The regex pattern is '\.\.[\\/]' with action BLOCK. Additionally, the WebACL has a size constraint rule blocking request bodies over 10MB. The WAF is configured with 'OversizeHandling' set to 'CONTINUE' for body inspection. CloudWatch metrics are enabled but no logging to S3/Firehose.

config.rule_details: RegexPatternSet match on SingleQueryArgument 'category' for pattern '\.\.[/\\]', action BLOCK
